evidence_convention: Every source citation points into the FAIR extraction's contextual excerpts. Line numbers are source-file lines from that extraction, not generated-report lines.

heatFl.role: Per-node working heat-flow value: initialized from the FEG field, conditionally derived/replaced, clamped, potentially corrected by thermal consistency, then written back.
heatFl.declaration_and_binding: REAL*8 INTENT(INOUT) argument of Assign; OrbData copies dQdTdA(iNode) into it before the call and copies it back after.
heatFl.units: Heat flow; source documents q limits in W/m^2 and the legacy parameter input documents heat-flow fields. See MOD_Data.f90:223,272; OrbData5.f90:484-486,545-546; OrbData5.f90:153-168.
heatFl.ARCANA_coverage: No canonical ARCANA nodal heat-flow input is currently bound; existing contracts identify this family as absent.

dQdTdA.role: Per-node FEG heat-flow field on input and OrbData-produced/modified field on output.
dQdTdA.declaration_and_binding: REAL*8 array populated by GetNet; read as the initial heatFl; written back after Assign and serialized by PutNet.
dQdTdA.units: Heat-flow field; the source's compiled q-limit units are W/m^2, while this extraction does not state a separate declaration-site unit for dQdTdA.
dQdTdA.ARCANA_coverage: No field currently bound by canonical R6 inputs.

needQ.role: Control flag set if any input node has exactly zero dQdTdA; in Assign it is the exact-zero test on heatFl.
needQ.declaration_and_binding: Local LOGICAL; derived from nodal input, not a physical parameter.

qArray.role: Grid-backed heat-flow source loaded if at least one node is zero; interpolation is performed only inside that node's needQ branch.
qArray.declaration_and_binding: Allocatable REAL*8 grid read from unit 4 when global needQ is true; passed into Assign.
qArray.ARCANA_coverage: ARCANA explicit pair does not provide qArray; whether this legacy grid is selected for any ARCANA run is unresolved.

qLim0.role: Compiled zero-elevation lower heat-flow limit; contributes to a lower-bound rule, with model-level effects despite its limit/control implementation.
qLim0.binding_and_units: REAL*8 PARAMETER in OrbData5; source documents W/m^2. The current qualified source default is recorded as evidence, not endorsed as an ARCANA choice.

dQL_dE.role: Compiled slope of the lower heat-flow limit versus elevation; numerical rule with direct physical-field consequences.
dQL_dE.binding_and_units: REAL*8 PARAMETER; source documents (W/m^2)/m. Current source default is not selected for ARCANA.

qLim1.role: Compiled upper heat-flow limit, and also the assigned heat-flow result for ageMa <= 0 in the ocean-age branch.
qLim1.binding_and_units: REAL*8 PARAMETER; source documents W/m^2. Its use as both cap and branch value means it is not merely a passive validation guard.

ageMa.role: Interpolated age-grid state used in legacy ocean/continental classification and the seafloor-age heat-flow law; ARCANA mode instead gates this route with explicit arcanaOcean.
ageMa.declaration_and_binding: REAL*8 local in Assign; interpolated from aArray. Extraction does not show an ARCANA age field in the governed explicit-input pair.
ageMa.units: Ma is explicit in variable name/source comments but no separate declaration-site units statement was extracted.
ageMa.age_zero_semantics: Code maps all ageMa <= 0 values to qLim1. Code does not establish whether age zero denotes valid newly formed oceanic lithosphere or a sentinel/input convention.
evidence: patches/shellset/R6_ORBDATA_ARCANA_EXPLICIT_INPUTS.patch: explicit domain/lithosphere pair and arcanaOcean routing

alphaT.role: Crust/mantle volumetric thermal expansion coefficients; consumed by the density/geotherm consistency calculation, not heat-flow routing itself.
alphaT.ARCANA_coverage: No R6-authorized material-specific values are bound; requires material/thermal configuration adjudication.

conduc.role: Crust/mantle thermal conductivity; converts heat flow and layer radiogenic production into geotherm gradients and enters the thermal consistency adjustment.
conduc.units: Parameter-file documentation states W/m/C for SI units.
conduc.ARCANA_coverage: No R6-authorized material-specific values are bound; values depend on chosen material/profile.

TSurf.role: Surface-temperature boundary/reference used to initialize the geotherm.
TSurf.ARCANA_coverage: Not bound as an R6 physical field/configuration choice in current contracts.

temLim.role: Per-layer melting-related temperature ceilings used when evaluating the crust/mantle temperature profiles.

TAsthK.role: Lithosphere/asthenosphere temperature computed from TAdiab + gradie * 100 km; used as target in geotherm checks/corrections.
TAsthK.units: Kelvin, explicitly stated by source comment; 100 km converted to meters.

TADIAB.role: Adiabat intercept parameter contributing to derived TAsthK.
TADIAB.units: Kelvin; INPUT parameter description pairs it with gradie as intercept and slope, respectively.
TADIAB.ARCANA_coverage: No ARCANA-authorized thermal profile/configuration is bound.

GRADIE.role: Adiabat slope parameter contributing to derived TAsthK.
GRADIE.units: K/m, explicitly stated in INPUT parameter description.
GRADIE.ARCANA_coverage: No ARCANA-authorized thermal profile/configuration is bound.

ZBASTH.role: Depth of the base of the upper mantle/olivine-rich layer in the parameter file; not part of heat-flow routing in Assign.
ZBASTH.units: meters, explicitly stated in parameter-file description.
ZBASTH.ARCANA_coverage: No ARCANA-authorized value selected; broader material/thermal adjudication remains open.

delta_rho_limit.role: Symmetric cap on chemical density anomaly; it is passed into Assign but does not participate in heat-flow source selection or q limits.

heat_flow_control_flow.description: GetNet reads qi into dQdTdA; OrbData copies the node's current value into heatFl before Assign.
OrbData scans the entire dQdTdA array. If any node is exactly zero, it loads qArray globally. If every node is nonzero, it skips the grid read.

Before the per-node Assign loop, nonzero dQdTdA values are raised to qLim0 + dQL_dE*elev if below that lower bound, then capped at qLim1. Zero nodes skip the lower-bound operation and remain zero at this stage.
Inside Assign, needQ is heatFl == 0. Only that branch interpolates qArray and assigns its result to heatFl.

Still within the needQ branch, the age-law branch applies for ARCANA explicit ocean nodes (arcanaMode AND arcanaOcean) or, outside ARCANA mode, ageMa < 200. It replaces the qArray value. For ageMa <= 0 it assigns qLim1; otherwise it uses the cited GDH1 piecewise age law.
After the missing-value branch closes, Assign applies qLim0 + dQL_dE*elevat as a floor and qLim1 as a cap to heatFl, regardless of whether it began as zero or nonzero.
Later, if the computed Moho temperature exceeds TAsthK, Assign changes heatFl by deltaQ and reapplies both q limits. Thus initially nonzero heat flow is not guaranteed to be preserved exactly.
OrbData copies the final heatFl back into dQdTdA and writes that value to output.

precedence_rules.zero_sentinel: YES. Equality with exactly 0.0D0 is the per-node needs-derivation sentinel in Assign; global qArray loading is triggered if any input node is exactly zero.
precedence_rules.qarray_scope: Global load conditional, per-node use conditional. qArray is loaded for the run when any node needs heat flow, but interpolation executes only for a node whose heatFl is zero.
precedence_rules.ocean_age_over_qarray: YES, for a zero/sentinel node that meets the ocean route predicate: age law overwrites the interpolated qArray result.
precedence_rules.ocean_age_over_nonzero_explicit_heatflow: NO in Assign: the entire qArray and age-overwrite block is nested under needQ. A nonzero nodal value bypasses both. However, pre-Assign lower/upper clamps and the later conditional geotherm correction still can change it.
precedence_rules.age_zero: Code behavior is unambiguous (ageMa <= 0 assigns qLim1 when the ocean-age branch is entered); authorial/physical interpretation of zero-age input is unresolved by source.
precedence_rules.arcana_ocean_vs_continent: In ARCANA mode, ocean heat-flow age routing uses arcanaOcean; the legacy ageMa < 200 classification is disabled by the predicate. Continental ARCANA nodes therefore receive no age-law override in this branch and, if heatFl is zero, use qArray plus limits. Explicit-domain assignment and the lithosphere path are in the governed patch; no new heat-flow physical law is created by the domain label.
precedence_rules.nonzero_preservation: Not exact. Nonzero bypasses qArray/age assignment but is clamped before Assign, clamped after the needQ block, and can be adjusted when test > TAsthK.
precedence_rules.limits: Lower bound is qLim0 + dQL_dE*elev; upper bound is qLim1. The same pair is reapplied after heat-flow correction. qLim1 is additionally used as the age<=0 output.
precedence_rules.density_limit: delta_rho_limit caps chemical_delta_rho only; no evidence connects it to heat-flow routing.

arcana_input_coverage.explicit_pair: The governed patch supplies ARCANA domain and total lithosphere grids and uses domain classification for arcanaOcean. It does not bind ARCANA nodal heat flow, seafloor age, or qArray values.
arcana_input_coverage.available_heat_flow_input: The OrbData interface can consume dQdTdA from the FEG; current ARCANA authority/contracts say no canonical nodal heat-flow payload is bound.
arcana_input_coverage.continental_nodes: If ARCANA mode classifies a node as continental and it has zero heatFl, the ocean age route is false; the remaining missing-value path is grid interpolation and limits. Whether that selected fallback is authorized for ARCANA remains open.

specialist_configuration_requirements.binding_path: Parameter file is read by ReadPm; ShellSetMain passes configuration through Variable_Update (including optional variable updates); OrbData derives TAsthK from TAdiab and gradie and passes thermal values into Assign.
specialist_configuration_requirements.classification_note: These are specialist physical-model configuration, not WORLD_HISTORY fields. Their actual ARCANA values/material associations remain unadjudicated. Units listed per symbol are source/parameter-file documentation only.

numerical_guards.name: heat-flow lower/upper limits
numerical_guards.interpretation: Compiled model limits that constrain generated and input heat flow; qLim1 also serves as the age<=0 branch value. Retention or replacement requires explicit ARCANA governance, not a literature search by default.

numerical_guards.name: chemical density anomaly bound
numerical_guards.interpretation: Separate symmetric numerical bound on chemical density anomaly, not heat-flow routing.

source_supported_ambiguities: The code assigns qLim1 for ageMa <= 0 but does not state whether zero is a valid newly formed oceanic age or an input sentinel; source alone cannot adjudicate physical meaning.

Current R6 explicit inputs do not supply nodal heat flow or a governed seafloor-age primitive. For zero heat flow, the source contains both qArray and ocean age-law routes, but ARCANA has not selected/authorized which input source is appropriate.
The qualified source documents existing q-limit constants and their operations, but R6 governance has not decided whether to retain those defaults, bound them, or replace them for ARCANA.
The extraction establishes parameter binding sites and legacy input documentation, not an ARCANA material-family assignment or an authoritative thermal parameter set.
unresolved_questions: What authorial WORLD_HISTORY primitive or authorized producer supplies T0 nodal heat flow, or the age/feature input from which a specialist may derive it?
For ARCANA ocean nodes, is an age-based GDH1 route intended, and what is the provenance/meaning of ageMa=0?
For ARCANA continental nodes with missing heat flow, is the legacy qArray fallback governed and what source grid is authoritative?
Should the qualified ShellSet qLim0/dQL_dE/qLim1 controls be inherited as model defaults, explicitly bounded, or replaced under ARCANA governance?
Which ARCANA material families and thermal profiles determine alphaT, conduc, radio, TSurf, temLim, TAdiab, gradie, and zBAsth?
Which scientific source establishes input values and uncertainty for heat flow, lithospheric age/cooling where applicable, and material-dependent thermal parameters?
scientific_choices_required: A governed T0 heat-flow source or physical primitive and its provenance; if age-derived, an authorial ocean-age/thermal-history primitive and a decision on age-zero semantics.

Material-family-specific thermal configuration (at minimum expansion coefficient and conductivity, plus the selected profile's heat production, surface/reference temperature, temperature ceiling and adiabat controls). Literature/source research is needed for these physical material/profile values and uncertainty; ShellSet example defaults are not ARCANA authority.
Whether ARCANA uses the GDH1 age law and the source/domain scope of that law.
Explicit governance disposition for qLim0, dQL_dE and qLim1 (retain as inherited ShellSet controls, bound, or replace); values are not chosen here.
scientific_choices_not_required: No additional physical law is needed to describe the qualified code's exact-zero sentinel, global qArray loading condition, per-node interpolation, clamp order, and write-back; these are implementation facts.

No heat-flow literature decision is needed for delta_rho_limit's code path: it limits chemical density anomaly and is separate from heat-flow routing. Its own governance belongs to material/density adjudication.

The mechanics of retaining or bounding q-limit controls can be adjudicated as model-control governance after physical input sources are chosen; literature is not automatically required to retain a qualified implementation control, though physical justification is required for changing its meaning/range.

requires_physical_literature_or_authoria: heat production and thermal profile parameters (TSurf, temLim, TAdiab, gradie, and related configuration)
research_vs_control_disposition.caveat: This distinction identifies the kind of adjudication required; it does not approve inherited defaults or assign any new parameter values.
